newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile approves Banco de Santiago plan.
newsitem.headline: Chile approves Banco de Santiago plan.

text.p: The Chilean Central Bank approved Banco de Santiago's plan to repay the $1.76 billion debts it owed the Central Bank.
The Central Bank's five-member council approved the plan for repayment of the debt, known as the subordinated debt, during an extraordinary session, said a Central Bank statement.

Banco de Santiago's merger with Banco O'Higgins, planned for later this year, had hinged on Central Bank approval for the debt repayment plan, which includes the placement of shares to be held by the Central Bank.
Banco de Santiago was the last major Chilean bank to refinance payment of its subordinated debts with the Central Bank under the terms of a law passed by Congress last year.
